usedFor: Artists use DeviantART to organise work into collection folders with “Create Folder” and “Update Folder”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Folder” in DeviantART
bestTemplate.why: A new booking can open a fresh collection folder for its pieces.

watchOut: “Update Folder” edits a folder that already exists, so check it points at the right one.
